verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Claude Code 'maps and explains entire codebases in a few seconds' using 'agentic search to understand project structure and dependencies without you having to manually select context files,' directly matching the story. This is corroborated by broader agentic capabilities (multi-file planning, git integration) but lacks independent hands-on validation of the codebase-mapping claim specifically. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of the automatic codebase-mapping claim, and any benchmark or demo showing accuracy on large unfamiliar repos.
